programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Oldtimer Show y carrera en el aeropuerto
programme.desc: En Paaren-Glien, cerca de Berlín, tiene lugar el show anual Oldtimer, que atrae a unos 45.000 visitantes ávidos por contemplar más de 5.000 tesoros automovilísticos. Frank y su equipo de Special Cars Berlin también asisten al evento trayendo consigo varios coches. Kati y Patrick viajan a Berlín con su Chevy. Al día siguiente, Fran participa en una carrera en el aeropuerto.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Hay nueva evidencia que sugiere que las personas llegaron a Norteamérica antes de lo que se creía, y que han viajado por caminos que ahora están cubiertos por el mar.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Hace 65 millones de años, una inmensa roca espacial se estrelló contra la Tierra y creo el equivalente a un invierno nuclear, matando a todos los dinosaurios.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Los misteriosos guerreros de las nubes de Peru
programme.desc: Los arqueólogos y los genetistas están descubriendo detalles de una de las civilizaciones más misteriosas de América del Sur pre-incáica.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Los papiros de Hercolano: descubriendo la historia
programme.desc: La erupción del monte Vesubio es conocida por haber diezmado a Pompeya, pero, cerca de allí, un asentamiento romano de magnitudes similares, conocido como Hercolano, se perdió para siempre.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.sub-title: Resucitando a los tigres de Tasmania
programme.desc: Profesionales de la genética trabajan para resucitar al enigmático tigre de Tasmania, que fue borrado de la faz de la Tierra por los seres humanos hace casi un siglo.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Profesionales de la geología provocaron un revuelo en Nueva Zelanda cuando declararon que habían descubierto el octavo continente. Descubre cómo se formó y cómo algo tan enorme pudo pasar inadvertido hasta ahora.

programme.title: Corvette C7 Descapotable
programme.desc: Probamos exhaustivamente el Chevrolet Corvette C7 Descapotable en las montañas.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Así es como se ve cuando los Héroes de Acción (Stunt Heroes) de la productora Action Concept realizan un gran salto: un vehículo salta a toda velocidad sobre cuatro coches que explotan uno tras otro. Es una cuestión de precisión y sincronización. La prometedora doble Tina tiene que demostrar lo que es capaz de hacer. ¡Espectacular escena llena de acción con moretones garantizados!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Los Héroes de Acción (Stunt Heroes) de la productora Action Concept están filmando el vuelco de un coche. Pero el coordinador de especialistas Carl quiere ir lo más lejos posible. Su lema es: si vas a hacer algo, debes hacerlo bien. Por lo tanto, añade un emocionante tiroteo a la escena. Además, durante el vuelco, quiere que Uwe se siente en el asiento del acompañante... ¡por primera vez!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: La mayoría de la gente nunca experimenta un accidente de coche en primera persona, pero conocen choques de coche espectaculares con enormes explosiones gracias al cine. Estas escenas son, por supuesto, exageradas ya que en la vida real los coches casi nunca explotan. Los Héroes de Acción (Stunt Heroes) muestran cómo se preparan estas escenas y qué trucos se hacen.

programme.title: McLaren 720 S
programme.desc: El McLaren 720S es el sucesor oficial del 650S y sigue unos pasos bastante importantes. Analizamos de cerca lo convincente que es en comparación con su predecesor.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Targa
programme.desc: Un descapotable con mucha potencia: el Porsche 911 Targa, el clásico de culto por excelencia.

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Hoy en día, el presidente Nixon es conocido sobre todo por sus escándalos. Pero ¿por qué ansiaba tanto la riqueza personal que ni siquiera se detuvo ante el abuso de poder? ¿Por qué ordenó allanar el edificio Watergate?

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Rara vez se abordan los verdaderos antecedentes, las causas y los factores que impulsaron la Guerra Civil Americana. ¿Qué empujó a la gente a este brutal conflicto que trajo sufrimiento, muerte y saqueos a la joven nación?

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Tras la derrota en la Guerra Civil, muchos sureños se mudaron a la costa oeste de California, donde querían restablecer las condiciones de los estados del sur. Lincoln mandó construir el ferrocarril transcontinental, entre otras cosas, para evitarlo.

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial, se desató la competencia entre los sistemas comunista de la Unión Soviética y capitalista de los Estados Unidos. Al principio, los frentes se trazaron principalmente en el ámbito político, económico y propagandístico.

programme.title: Virus: desctrucción y creación
programme.desc: ¿Qué es un virus? ¿Cómo afecta a los seres humanos y cómo se propaga? Médicos, virólogos y científicos examinan el virus del Zika y estudian cómo se puede prevenir la propagación de enfermedades en el futuro.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Hace 66 millones de años, un asteroide se estrelló en la península de Yucatán, México, y provocó una extinción masiva de dinosaurios. Con más de 700.000 asteroides en el espacio, ¿qué les espera a la humanidad y a nuestro planeta si eso vuelve a suceder?

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Nadie tiene más éxito que Porsche Racing. Con más de 28.000 victorias en 65 años, Porsche estableció un récord mundial. La leyenda de los rallies Walter Röhrl y el ganador de Le Mans Hans Hermann también comentan el éxito de Porsche Racing.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: El placer de conducir: BMW, uno de los grupos automovilísticos más exitosos del mundo, promete eso. Los automóviles y motocicletas deportivas de Bavarian Motorenwerke AG son igualmente populares entre los clientes y en los deportes de carrera

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Es el Porsche "James Dean". Es pequeño, plano y rápido. Sólo se construyó 140 veces y, sin embargo, el Porsche 550 Spider hace historia: es el coche en el que la leyenda de Hollywood James Dean muere en un accidente.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Henry Ford abrió el camino de la revolución automovilística a principios del siglo XX. Con el Modelo T de Ford, la empresa conquistó no sólo los Estados Unidos, sino el mundo entero, y convirtió a su inventor en uno de los hombres más ricos.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Pocos fabricantes han sido tan activos en Estados Unidos y Europa como Ford, y con éxito. Mientras el Mustang entusiasmaba a la juventud americana, el Capri hacía girar las cabezas de los europeos.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: El Ruf RT35 puede parecer un Porsche, pero no lo es. Desde 1981, la empresa Ruf de Pfaffhausen (Alemania) está reconocida como fabricante independiente. Sin embargo, la base de los vehículos procede exclusivamente de Porsche.

programme.title: Rimac Concept One
programme.desc: El coche eléctrico más rápido, potente y caro del mundo. Este superdeportivo no se ajusta a la norma. El futurista Rimac Concept One es extremadamente plano y potente. Aunque el coche es relativamente pesado, la capacidad de aceleración es enorme.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka es un apasionado de la velocidad y constantemente participa en eventos de carreras, como la legendaria Race 61, a 50 kilómetros al norte de Berlín. Aquí es donde los participantes de toda Europa compiten en el Air-Strip del museo de la aviación en la carrera de un octavo de milla. Frank compite con su Dragster-Camaro de 700 caballos de fuerza para defender el título.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE llega a America - Nueva York
programme.desc: El empresario alemán Tillmann Miritz comienza su sueño en la ciudad que nunca duerme: un viaje por carretera con su propio coche vintage hacia los iconos automovilísticos de su juventud. Con su Mercedes 280 SE 3.5 descapotable visita al legendario distribuidor de coches clásicos Eliot Cuker de Nueva York, que hizo su fortuna con su pasión por los coches antiguos en el centro de Manhattan.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE llega a America - Long Island
programme.desc: El recorrido de Tillmann Miritz para encontrar rarezas automovilísticas en los EE.UU. va desde el puente de Manhattan hasta Long Island. Su Mercedes descapotable lo lleva al viñedo Wöllfer Estate, donde se cultivan algunos de los mejores vinos. Su dueño esconde en el garaje una camioneta que representa el "American Way of Life" rural como casi ningún otro coche: el Chevrolet 3100.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Chevelle y Down Town Garage
programme.desc: Kati y Patrick son grandes fanáticos de los coches americanos y orgullosos propietarios de un Chevrolet Chevelle de 1972 pero quieren comprar un motor más grande. Por eso visitan a los especialistas de Down Town Garage con más de 50 motores. El lugar es también un restaurante americano con un motel donde puedes pasar la noche con un estilo genuino.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Oldtimer Show y carrera en el aeropuerto
programme.desc: En Paaren-Glien, cerca de Berlín, tiene lugar el show anual Oldtimer, que atrae a unos 45.000 visitantes ávidos por contemplar más de 5.000 tesoros automovilísticos. Frank y su equipo de Special Cars Berlin también asisten al evento trayendo consigo varios coches. Kati y Patrick viajan a Berlín con su Chevy. Al día siguiente, Fran participa en una carrera en el aeropuerto.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: Ponga su carro en la TV
programme.desc: Se invita a los maníacos de los coches a traer sus vehículos tuneados a "The Walk", en la playa de Jumeirah, para que sean juzgados por su velocidad, estilo y sonido. En este episodio, un Chevrolet Camaro y un Mercedes SLS AMG intentarán sorprender.

programme.title: Ponga su carro en la TV
programme.desc: Pon tu coche en la tele invita a los propietarios de coches a que los califique Saif Hattawi. La persona con más puntos ganará un regalo especial del Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Incluye: un BMW X5 y un Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: Ponga su carro en la TV
programme.desc: La gente de Oriente Medio está loca por sus coches. En Put Your Car on TV, pueden presentar sus vehículos tuneados y calificados. Entre los competidores de hoy se encuentran un Nova SS, un Honda Acord especial y un coche lleno de cristales.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS
programme.desc: Los grandes alerones traseros sugieren que hay mucha potencia escondida bajo el capó que debe ser controlada, ya que estos alerones proporcionan la carga aerodinámica necesaria. El Porsche GT3 RS tiene un alerón trasero muy especial.

programme.title: Mustang
programme.desc: El Ford Mustang Shelby GT-500 nació de la vibra de los 60 y la experiencia en carreras de Carroll Shelby. Su estilo "boulevard cruiser" y su potente motor lo hicieron un éxito de ventas.

programme.title: Corvette
programme.desc: El Split-window Stingray Coupe de 1963 combinaba potencia, desempeño, precisión y diseño juvenil. Su estilo único, elegante y progresivo lo convirtió en un favorito eterno entre los fanáticos de los autos y los coleccionistas.

programme.title: Oldsmobile
programme.desc: El Oldsmobile F88 era el "auto soñado" de la línea de GM Oldsmobile, pero el auto, a pesar de su estilo sofisticado y encantador, no estaba destinado a entrar en producción.

programme.title: Pierce Arrow
programme.desc: 1913 38C Brougham - "construído con un estándar alto, no a precio reducido" - merecía el valor de varias casas del momento, con la distinción especial de ser el primer auto de la Casa Blanca.

programme.title: Duesenberg
programme.desc: El modelo 1930 J Duesenberg fue la cima de la ingeniería automotriz en potencia y velocidad, con récords que no fueron superados hasta 1960. Los magnates como Hearst, el rey de España y la estrella del cine Gary Cooper fueron dueños de Duesenbergs.

programme.title: Terraplane
programme.desc: El Terraplane 1937 Serie 72 de Hudson fue un auto rápido y asequible con estilo único y diseño innovador. Pero también era confiable y estaba bien construído, entonces la empresa, a diferencia de otras, sobrevivió la Gran Depresión.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Construcción ligera
programme.desc: Tuvimos la suerte de probar uno de los 29 Mercedes 300 SL "mariposa" construidos para su primera carrera de la Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia: Coche de ensueño y clásico de culto
programme.desc: Un proyecto ambicioso. En los años 50, el Facel Vega Facellia se desarrolló para competir con Porsche y Alfa y para llevar a la joven empresa automovilística francesa a un nuevo segmento de compradores. Un plan que sale terriblemente mal.

programme.title: 120 años de deportes de motor de Mercedes
programme.desc: El primer "Mercedes" se entrega a finales de 1900. Con su bajo centro de gravedad, su chasis de acero prensado y su radiador de nido de abeja, el Mercedes se considera hoy el primer automóvil moderno construido como coche de carreras.

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Hoy en día, el presidente Nixon es conocido sobre todo por sus escándalos. Pero ¿por qué ansiaba tanto la riqueza personal que ni siquiera se detuvo ante el abuso de poder? ¿Por qué ordenó allanar el edificio Watergate?

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Rara vez se abordan los verdaderos antecedentes, las causas y los factores que impulsaron la Guerra Civil Americana. ¿Qué empujó a la gente a este brutal conflicto que trajo sufrimiento, muerte y saqueos a la joven nación?

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Tras la derrota en la Guerra Civil, muchos sureños se mudaron a la costa oeste de California, donde querían restablecer las condiciones de los estados del sur. Lincoln mandó construir el ferrocarril transcontinental, entre otras cosas, para evitarlo.

programme.title: Hi$toria
programme.desc: Tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial, se desató la competencia entre los sistemas comunista de la Unión Soviética y capitalista de los Estados Unidos. Al principio, los frentes se trazaron principalmente en el ámbito político, económico y propagandístico.

programme.title: Virus: desctrucción y creación
programme.desc: ¿Qué es un virus? ¿Cómo afecta a los seres humanos y cómo se propaga? Médicos, virólogos y científicos examinan el virus del Zika y estudian cómo se puede prevenir la propagación de enfermedades en el futuro.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Hace 66 millones de años, un asteroide se estrelló en la península de Yucatán, México, y provocó una extinción masiva de dinosaurios. Con más de 700.000 asteroides en el espacio, ¿qué les espera a la humanidad y a nuestro planeta si eso vuelve a suceder?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: McLaren es una de las marcas de automóviles más famosas de Gran Bretaña. Apenas hay coches deportivos que fascinen tanto como un McLaren o que tengan una herencia tan legendaria en el automovilismo. Dos modelos recientes de McLaren son el 650S y la serie limitada P1. Supercars tiene ganas de amar y cita al McLaren 650S en una antigua zona industrial y en la pista de carreras.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Hay detalles que diferencian a los supercoches de los coches normales y estos detalles son esenciales. Los supercoches son los coches más grandes, más ruidosos y más caros de la carretera; son obras de arte de cuatro ruedas.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: La Dolce Vita - 100 anos de Maserati
programme.desc: Para celebrar su centenario, Maserati se ha premiado a sí misma con un precioso coupé llamado Maserati Alfiere. Pero eso no es todo. La compañía invita a un viaje de Bolonia a Turín con los modelos más bellos de las últimas décadas. Supercars participa en este viaje con un Granturismo MC Stradale.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Se llama Mulsanne, Bentely Mulsanne. El nuevo buque insignia de Bentley alcanza una velocidad máxima cercana a los 300 km/h, es lujoso como un hotel de primera clase y elegante como un traje de Armani. Supercars revela qué se siente al conducir un coche de ensueño como éste. Además: Supercars echa un vistazo al extraordinario Rolls Royce Ghost y al coupé de alta tecnología Mercedes S 63 AMG.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: El lujo no significa necesariamente perder el tiempo. El híbrido es una de las técnicas que promete un menor consumo de combustible con un motor aún potente. Lexus es el pionero en la electrificación de los coches. Supercars conduce el nuevo LS 600h, el BMW Actiev Hybrid 7 y el Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: La Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse, en Austria, es el terreno de juego ideal para los ligeros Lotus Elise y Roding Roadster. Estos dos roadsters están pegados a la calle y, por tanto, son muy divertidos de conducir.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.desc: La subida a la colina de Pikes Peak de 1987. Un tipo de carrera bastante diferente en las montañas de Colorado, EE.UU.. Es única, fascinante y llena de aventura.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.sub-title: Carreras clasicas - Carreras del Gran Premio desde 1934
programme.desc: Desde 1934, el Gran Premio ha sido el campeonato mundial más emocionante y fascinante del mundo. Con sus vehículos de última generación, con los caballos de potencia de las marcas más grandes, nunca deja de impresionar a sus espectadores.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.sub-title: Carreras clasicas - Ano de Rallye 1972 - Una historia de exito de Ford
programme.desc: El campeonato internacional de fabricantes fue una serie de rallyes que se desarrolló entre 1970 y 72. Fabricantes de coches como Porsche, Renault y Ford participaron, con Ford teniendo un año excepcionalmente exitoso en 1972.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.sub-title: Carreras clasicas - El Campeonato Aleman de Turismos
programme.desc: El campeonato alemán de coches de turismo de 1992: definitivamente una de las series de carreras más importantes del deporte del motor alemán. Duro, despiadado y bien conocido por las duras batallas de sus despiadados competidores.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.sub-title: Carreras clasicas - El Campeonato de Turismos en Argentina 1964
programme.desc: Temperaturas tropicales, polvo interminable y curvas - algunas de las muchas dificultades para el hombre y la máquina durante el gran premio de 1964 en Argentina. Esta carrera fue la responsable de llevar a la marca Mercedes a la cima.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.desc: Curiosa por todo y entusiasmada por la ciencia, Luna, de 6 años, y su hermano Júpiter y su mascota Clyde exploran la naturaleza para conocer el mundo.

programme.title: Leoncito Alado
programme.desc: LEONCITO ALADO es un canal de canciones infantiles para niños de 1 a 3 años de edad. Aquí podrás encontrar canciones para tranquilizar, entretener y enseñar valores y talentos a nuestros pequeños espectadores.

programme.title: Planeta de Niños
programme.desc: Divertida y cautivadora serie educativa y de entretenimiento para niños, que refuerza virtudes fundamentales y modales enseñados a los niños por sus padres y maestros, en la escuela y en casa. Desde la confianza, humildad y el perdón, a la honestidad, responsabilidad, cooperación y dignidad. El show ayuda a los niños a comprender la importancia desde pequeños detalles como ser corteses, hasta a desarrollar grandes virtudes y habilidades, como saber toma de decisiones.

programme.title: La linterna mágica
programme.desc: La serie animada «La linterna mágica» se encargará de contarles a los más pequeñitos maravillosas historias de aventuras basadas en clásicos literarios. Cada historia se presenta en una película de filminas que mira y discute un joven amante de los videojuegos llamado Mike y una sabelotodo llamada Kate. Los simpáticos personajes nos permitirán ver historias clásicas desde un ángulo diferente y nos demostrarán que los clásicos pueden ser divertidos e interesantes.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Leo Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger presenta los secretos y las maravillas de la naturaleza y la vida silvestre que nos rodea y estimula la curiosidad y la pasión por la naturaleza en los niños. Con interesantes misiones y aventuras, los niños se divierten mientras aprenden lecciones positivas.

programme.title: Bjorn y Bucky
programme.desc: "Bjorn y Bucky tienen que ver con la amistad y la capacidad de vivir bien con la tecnología en nuestro mundo natural moderno. ¡Bucky es un oso Pardo de alta energía que ama los gadgets, la tecnología y el Werkzeuge! El oso polar Bjorn es un niño de la naturaleza que ama relajarse, meditar e incluso aquí y allá. El amigo de los osos Jr., Franny Fox, juega un papel importante, y en algunos episodios puede tener un número significativo de pistas. Las historias tienden a contar sobre el conflicto creado por un enfoque demasiado técnico de la situación y la búsqueda de una solución en la naturaleza, o viceversa. La serie es positiva, cómica y optimista. Estos temas tienen como objetivo ayudar a las personas a ver que es posible vivir en armonía con la naturaleza mientras viven una vida moderna rica, llena de ciencia y tecnología."

programme.title: Iron Kid
programme.desc: Gaff, Guardián de la Familia Eon y protector del Puño, está huyendo de la asesina a sueldo Belleza Negra y su equipo de Ninjas Robots. Escapa por poco de su ataque y arroja una caja de madera en una cueva de la Zona Prohibida, un área controlada por el Duque von Rhymer, presidente de la Torre de Hierro. La caja contiene el Puño de Eón.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: Maderitas
programme.desc: Maderitas – es una serie de películas animadas para niños en edad preescolar.Los protagonistas son juguetes de madera: la Gatita Miau, el Perrito Guau Guau, el Cerdito Oink, el Caballito Ico Co y el Elefantito Du Du. Estos juguetes viven en una pequeña ciudad de madera (prototipo de una habitación de juego para niños). Cada juguete tiene su carácter y reacciona a su manera a los sucesos que ocurren. Guiados por la voz de un narrador invisible los juguetes junto con los espectadores superan diferentes obstáculos, juegan y viven sus aventuras. “Maderitas” es una serie musical con muchos bailes y canciones. Algunas de esas canciones representan a nuestros protagonistas y se escuchan en cada episodio. Otras canciones están relacionadas con los hechos que ocurren en el episodio, y por eso solo se escuchan en determinados capítulos. En los episodios hay elementos educativos en forma de juego. Los juguetes junto con los espectadores van conociendo los colores, las formas, objetos, encuentran solución a situaciones difíciles, aprenden a ser verdaderos amigos, a ayudarse los unos a los otros, exploran el mundo. Los episodios son positivos, humanos y con buen sentido de humor.

programme.title: Pim y Pom en el Museo
programme.desc: Pim y Pom, dos gatitos, llevan a los niños a una aventura en el fascinante mundo del arte. Con la fuerza de su imaginación, exploran cuadros de artistas famosos como Vincent van Gogh, Johannes Vermeer, Rembrandt, Seurat y Renoir.

Otras canciones están relacionadas con los hechos que ocurren en el episodio, y por eso solo se escuchan en determinados capítulos. En los episodios hay elementos educativos en forma de juego. Los juguetes junto con los espectadores van conociendo los colores, las formas, objetos, encuentran solución a situaciones difíciles, aprenden a ser verdaderos amigos, a ayudarse los unos a los otros, exploran el mundo. Los episodios son positivos, humanos y con buen sentido de humor.

programme.title: Iron Kid
programme.desc: Gaff, Guardián de la Familia Eon y protector del Puño, está huyendo de la asesina a sueldo Belleza Negra y su equipo de Ninjas Robots. Escapa por poco de su ataque y arroja una caja de madera en una cueva de la Zona Prohibida, un área controlada por el Duque von Rhymer, presidente de la Torre de Hierro. La caja contiene el Puño de Eón.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Maderitas
programme.desc: Maderitas – es una serie de películas animadas para niños en edad preescolar.Los protagonistas son juguetes de madera: la Gatita Miau, el Perrito Guau Guau, el Cerdito Oink, el Caballito Ico Co y el Elefantito Du Du. Estos juguetes viven en una pequeña ciudad de madera (prototipo de una habitación de juego para niños). Cada juguete tiene su carácter y reacciona a su manera a los sucesos que ocurren. Guiados por la voz de un narrador invisible los juguetes junto con los espectadores superan diferentes obstáculos, juegan y viven sus aventuras. “Maderitas” es una serie musical con muchos bailes y canciones. Algunas de esas canciones representan a nuestros protagonistas y se escuchan en cada episodio. Otras canciones están relacionadas con los hechos que ocurren en el episodio, y por eso solo se escuchan en determinados capítulos. En los episodios hay elementos educativos en forma de juego. Los juguetes junto con los espectadores van conociendo los colores, las formas, objetos, encuentran solución a situaciones difíciles, aprenden a ser verdaderos amigos, a ayudarse los unos a los otros, exploran el mundo. Los episodios son positivos, humanos y con buen sentido de humor.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.desc: En Marsella, las bandas se disputan ferozmente el control del mercado de la droga, que genera más de treinta millones de euros al mes. Esta actividad de narcotráfico afecta a diversos sectores, como el inmobiliario y los clubes deportivos. La policía, en particular la Oficina Antinarcóticos, trabaja activamente para desmantelar este negocio y ha detenido a 8.000 traficantes en el primer semestre de 2021. Muchos pandilleros están armados, y la violencia ha causado daños a personas inocentes, dejando a familias en el sufrimiento.

programme.title: Heroes of Envell
programme.desc: Present days. Saint Petersburg. Four friends – Art, Kira, Phil and Vic are the coolest gamers in school. Eventually they find a suspicious laptop with «Heroes of Envell» game installed on it. Turns out that this very laptop is a portal to another dimension, a game realm which is full of adventures and real-life danger. The game realm is a blend of medieval, steampunk and futurism. You never know what really awaits our heroes. Just like the design of the game, the game logic is very unpredictable. You start with a quest and then it becomes a race right until it all grows into a tricky brainteaser. But be sure about one thing – there is no boring or easy way in here. programme.title: Woodventures
programme.desc: "Woodventures" is an animated series for preschool children. The main characters are wooden toys: Kitty Meow, Doggy Woof-Woof, Piggy Oink, Horsey Yee-Ho-Ho and Elephant Pawoo. The toys live in a small wooden town (the prototype of a child's play room). Every toy has its own unique personality and reacts to different circumstances appropriately. With the help of the invisible narrator, the toys, along with the audience solve different tasks, play and take part in adventures. "Woodventures" is a musical series with lots of songs and dances. Some of the songs represent our characters and appear in each series, and some of the songs are related to the events in the series, so it is only found in that particular episode.Each episode presents a playful and learning environment.

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany and Sheka are not the only ones who accuse their ex-boyfriend, Erik, of constant lying and scamming throughout their relationships. Today, Dr. Phil hears from ex-girlfriends Torri and Courtney, and even Erik’s ex-wife, Martha, who all have different stories to share about Erik’s deceitful behavior. Now that Erik has been revealed as an alleged con man, will he decide to change his ways? Find out at the end of this dramatic part 2.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andy and his wife, Bridget, say they were petrified after receiving a call from a scammer posing as a kidnapper who claimed he was holding their daughter, Sam, hostage for ransom money. Dr. Phil explains to the frightened couple that this trending scam is called “virtual kidnapping,” as he instructs the audience on how to recognize these types of scammers. Then, Dr. Phil meets with Debra Newell, the real woman behind the popular podcast and hit Bravo series Dirty John. Debra was a single, successful business owner who had raised her four children when she decided she was ready to go online to try to find love. Then, Debra met John, a man who first seemed like a charming, intelligent doctor but later revealed he was emotionally abusive with a dangerous and criminal past. Detective Julia Bowman also talks about how unbeknownst to Debra, she had arrested John in 2013 for stalking and harassing an ex, and he later tried to put a hit out on the detective.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Affairs, fights, lies and dark secrets threaten a marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look into the nanny affair that shattered a marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Relatives want their loved ones to think twice before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A headline making story of a husband’s affair with a co-worker that led to murder. Now the wife and the mistress come face to face for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Secrets are revealed in a family with a shopaholic wife and rageaholic husband.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to Tiffany Tehan, dubbed the “Runaway Mom” and the family of missing mom, Julie Ann Gonzalez.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two, the estranged husband of missing mom, Julie Ann Gonzalez, takes a polygraph test.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Son Believes He’s a Cyborg
programme.desc: Can Dr. Phil convince a 24 yo NYU grad that he’s not a cyborg from the future?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is There a Predator in the House?
programme.desc: As a parent, you're likely to be concerned about sexual predators who could potentially gain access to your child. But what if you suspected a child molester were living under the same roof as your child or grandchild? Dr. Phil tackles the stories of two concerned moms.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever had a problem where you wondered, am I the only one who is dealing with this? Lori says that after 18 years of marriage, she thinks she may be a lesbian. Her husband thinks she’s going through a phase and wants their normal life back. Dr. Phil and psychotherapist and sexologist Dr. Michele Angello weigh in. Then, Sarah, 21, wants to know if it’s normal that she loves films that are disturbing, shocking and disgusting. Her mother says she doesn’t understand her daughter’s love of bloody, gory and utterly terrifying movies. And, Lynda says she has a master’s degree but can only find a job as a model. She says no one will take her seriously, and she is judged because of her looks. Could there be another reason she can’t land a job in her chosen career?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pastor Ronald Williams and his late wife, Patti, founded Hephzibah House in 1971, a Christian boarding school for teen girls. Kalie, Susan, and Gabby say they want to raise awareness about Hephzibah House, where they claim they experienced abuse that still haunts them to this day. But Lucinda, another former student, is defending the work she says Pastor Williams has done. For the first time ever, Ben, the founder’s son, speaks out. You won’t want to miss this episode.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kalie, Susan, and Gabby say they want to shutdown Hephzibah House, a Christian boarding school they were forced to attend as teens. They say they believe the girls in that home are at great risk, but another former student, Lucinda, says these women need to stop all the allegations because the home was a safe haven for her and many other girls. You won’t want to miss this conclusion as a former volunteer staff member joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: No matter how much we try to avoid it, conflict is a part of life. But what happens when an entire family points the finger at one person as the source of the chaos?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Drug use, faking a heart attack, parental alienation – can these exes stop making accusations and come together for the sake of their children?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there something you’ve been hanging on to for just a little too long? Clothes you haven’t fit into since high school? Boxes of stuff you haven’t looked at in years? Dr. Phil’s guests say their loved ones need to call the junk yard and “Get rid of it!” Kim says her husband, Paul’s, Star Warshobby has to go. With over 6,000 pieces in his collection, Paul spends 30 hours a week playing with his action figures, building models and talking to friends about Star Wars. He even had a light saber sword fight at their wedding, so shouldn’t Kim have known what she was getting into? Next, Larry and Sheila married four months ago, but Sheila says she had no idea she was getting hitched to a hoarder. Larry says she’s got it all wrong -– she’s the pack rat! With some of their favorite collections rolled out on stage, can Dr. Phil help them negotiate what goes and what stays? Plus, meet Terri, who has four storage units and two garages full of sentimental memories -– like a rubber chicken and her father’s spine X-rays! She spends so much money storing her stuff, that she can’t even afford health insurance. What’s at the heart of her hoarding? Don’t miss this hilarious look at how collections can get out of control!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are deadbeat dads actually dead broke dads? As the American economy struggles, men comprise most of the recent layoffs. In child support cases, are men and women treated equally in the courts, or are the laws out of touch with today's crisis? Dr. Phil's guests, along with Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, and Lis Wiehl, author and legal analyst, debate the issue that has many men feeling like the laws are against them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two moms ask Dr. Phil to give their sons a reality check. Rita says her son, Eric, changed his name to “King Keith” and is forgoing a college education to pursue a singing career. Has he lost touch with reality? And, Cheryl says her college-educated son, Patrick, is lazy and lacks ambition.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On the surface these guests appear to have it all, but what shocking secrets are they hiding behind closed doors? Sherie thinks she's just a "fashion queen" and a shopaholic. Now that she's been arrested for embezzling about $50,000, will she get real about her problem before her next outfit is a prison uniform? Then, Tanaiya and Ed are a wealthy, attractive couple who are the envy of everyone they know. But behind closed doors, Tanaiya walks on pins and needles around her husband. And, behind Jennifer’s tough exterior, she’s silently fighting fear and terror every single day. It’s time for these guests – and you – to start living true to your authentic self.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How can you change a racist's thinking? How can someone who has had a racist viewpoint his entire life learn to accept a biracial granddaughter? Catch up on Charlie's story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you struggling to tame your rebellious teen? Chris and Barbara say their 17-year-old daughter, Courtney, is out of control! The teen proudly admits she bullies, steals, drinks and does drugs and is consumed with anger. Can Dr. Phil set her straight? Parents: If you know a teen who’s heading down a dangerous path, this is one show you can't afford to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they saw several red flags before they walked down the aisle, but they looked the other way and still said, "I do."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Friend is Obsessed with Me
programme.desc: Traci says her former friend, Jinda, is obsessed and infatuated with her. Traci says Jinda began texting her about 50 times a day after they first met -- texts that soon became over-the-top proclamations such as, “I can’t get you out of my mind," and “I swear I will love you the right way.” Traci says she thought Jinda just needed a friend but then grew more uncomfortable as, she claims, Jinda was also inappropriately affectionate with her children, began texting her friends whom she had never met, and even tried to touch and kiss her. Traci claims Jinda crossed the line when she tried to sabotage her marriage, so she cut off communication with her. But is Jinda getting the message? Traci says Jinda still texts and drives by her house, and she worries what Jinda might do next. Jinda admits to being "needy and clingy" but does she see that she's overstepped her boundaries? Can Dr. Phil help her rein in her behavior? Then, Kari says her sister, Holly, stabbed her in the back when she took Kari’s ex-husband’s side during their divorce -- and, after not speaking for three years, she wants an apology. Holly says she’s not sorry and that Kari is the one who needs to apologize. Can Dr. Phil end the silence between these sisters?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A pageant mom’s 9 yo beauty queen’s photos ended up on a risque website. Who’s to blame?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women panic about meeting their prince charming before it’s too late. But are these single women their own worst enemy? Dr. Phil talks to one woman whose best friend is tired of hearing her sing the blues. Is she cursed or just too judgmental? Next, a black woman says she married a white man and wants her sister to consider it too. So how does her sister feel about it? Plus, a woman who lost 180 lbs. says she still can’t trust men. Can Dr. Phil help her get past her anger and resentment?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jeremy owns his own funeral escort company but says he’s being falsely accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been leaked online, received millions of views, and as a result, he is being victimized in his community and misrepresented in the media – and now, he and his attorney want to set the record straight. Dr. Phil meets Jeremy and takes a closer look into components of his business, including his motorcycle, uniform and badge. Is Jeremy “playing cop” or just doing his job? And, what’s on Jeremy’s duty belt? You won’t want to miss part one of this two-part show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Jeremy, a funeral escort, who is being accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been edited and leaked online, and as a result, he is being defamed and bullied in the media. But, Jeremy says the world has it all wrong and wants to clear his name. Today, Dr. Phil meets a funeral director who has worked with Jeremy for seven years, as well as someone who’s been following his story from afar. What do they have to say? Plus, to help prove his intention is not to impersonate a police officer, Jeremy requested a polygraph test. What does the test reveal? Tune in to find out.

programme.desc: Anthony believes his ex, Erica and her new boyfriend Jeremy are abusing his son. Next, Lacey is being accused, by her aunt, of physically abusing and neglecting her two young children.

programme.sub-title: I Have Proof, You're Abusing Our Child
programme.desc: Robert says he believes that his daughters mother has been abusing her and he wants to prove the abuse and gain full custody of his daughter. Then, Casey claims her ex-boyfriend is abusive towards their kids and she wants him out of their lives.

programme.sub-title: How Could You Cover for Him?
programme.desc: Gina believes her grandson is being abused by her daughter's boyfriend Efrain. Her daughter wants to prove that he's innocent and is furious at her mom for accusing him. Was Gina right or is Efrain really innocent?

programme.title: He'll Still Never Let Go
programme.desc: In the wake of her abusive ex-boyfriend Karlton's disappearance, Candace seeks a fresh start. Just as she begins to open her heart to new love, Brandon, his reckless actions inadvertently expose her to danger, unaware that Karlton is silently watching. With her past closing in and her safety at risk, Candace must confront her deepest fears and fight to reclaim her freedom before Karlton's sinister plans destroy her chance at happiness.

programme.title: Troublesome
programme.desc: Veteran homicide detective Michael reluctantly partners with rookie Derrick. Witnessing a double homicide, they survive a deadly chase, but Derrick is wounded. The suspects are linked to the kingpin, who retaliates by ordering murders across the city. As chaos erupts, the FBI joins the case, revealing the kingpin's identity. Michael finds a weak link, offering a chance to finally catch him.

programme.title: It Is What it is
programme.desc: Victoria, a sophisticated young woman, is trying to find happiness with a good man in the midst of drugs and violence in the mean streets of KC.

programme.title: Twerk: Reggae Nights
programme.desc: Hard-working, single mother, Iesha, learns that one of the most popular reggae artists, Domino, is holding an audition in her city for dancers in his next music video. The competition is fierce, and some of the ladies will do anything to get the job.

programme.title: Liquid Dreams
programme.desc: The Dawkins brothers, navigating new careers and relationships, find their bond tested when a wild night of partying sets off a chain of events. Years after their initial adventures, they face fresh challenges that threaten to tear them apart.

programme.title: Make it Rain
programme.desc: After struggling to find a job following graduation, Mone' is enticed by her best friend Lala to audition at a local strip club. She enters the seductive underworld of the strip club, experiencing financial success and personal challenges. As Mone' navigates the dark side of the industry, she must confront betrayal, addiction, tragedy, and ultimately find the strength to rebuild her life and pursue her dreams.

programme.title: Smash and Dash
programme.desc: Clarence, a Chef from Chicago, is very passionate about two things, food and love. After being jilted at the altar, Clarence's friends Lakeith and Buddy, immediately urge him to get back into the dating pool, but under one condition, and that is for him to "Smash and Dash.” Clarence needs to hook up with as many women as he possibly can through a dating app without falling in love.

programme.title: GRIT
programme.desc: Three estranged brothers, Jason Jarell, and Josiah, are brought together by their sister Laura’s death. The brothers make a pact to uncover the truth behind her murder, setting off a perilous journey into the dark political world, where they forge unexpected alliances in order to get justice for Laura.

programme.title: Sugar Daddy Killer
programme.desc: Sasha has just ended a relationship with her boyfriend and is looking for a fresh start. Her friend Tonya tells her she needs to get a Sugar Daddy to forget about her boyfriend, and get her bills paid. Sasha starts dating a Sugar Daddy and decides she is going to scam him. When Sasha’s Sugar Daddy wants more than conversation, she is forced to kill him. Now Sasha decides to start killing one Sugar Daddy after the next to get all the money she can.

programme.title: 10 Kilos in the Trunk
programme.desc: Tonya needs to make some quick cash for the holidays, and takes a job transporting cocaine. On the way to the drop-off, her car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. While walking to a gas station for help, she is stopped by a police officer, and arrested for several warrants. Now in jail, Tonya, gets her friend Monica to make the delivery. Monica must get the car fixed, avoid a thief looking to steal the product, and make the delivery by the deadline or both will face deadly consequences.

programme.title: Bad For You
programme.desc: Paris McMillan works as an undercover FBI agent taking down known crime rings in the city. When she meets Liam after a one-night stand, she discovers that he is her next target. Now she has to make the difficult decision about loyalty or love.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: Thicker the Berry the Sweeter the Juice 2
programme.desc: Rising Celebrity News Reporter, Cherish has old flames and new loves collide when her past with her ex-Khalil returns, alongside the return of Caine, who threatens everything she’s built. Will She choose true love or stay the course for her career?

programme.title: Trapped in the Game: Fool Me Once
programme.desc: When FBI agent Dallas Bush is assigned to take down a powerful businessman turned drug lord, he realizes the payout could cover his dying mother’s medical expenses. Dallas must navigate a dangerous web of deception, crime, and moral compromise, where every choice comes with a price.

programme.title: Priceless: The Score

Now they are racing against time to right their wrongs and save their own lives before they are next in a string of murders. Meanwhile their partner Seven, has fallen victim to the deadliest of them all; the Black widow.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

She had acute myeloid leukemia, a type of blood cancer. As this type of Leukemia can be aggressive, Daymara immediately began an intensive chemotherapy regime and a groundbreaking stem cell procedure that would eventually save her life. This stem cell procedure however would force her into isolation as her immune system was weakened. Regardless of what may have seemed like an insurmountable challenge, Daymara persevered and her determination to leave the hospital so she could be with her children again is what Daymara says gave her hope and the ability to get well again.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Early on in Rachel Collin's pregnancy, she was told there was a concern for her unborn child as doctors discovered her baby's heart was undeveloped. Soon hopes were dashed and worry set in as Rachel was told the future was uncertain for her baby boy. Hope is Here chronicles the first two years of Mikey Collins' life, who proved to be a brave little boy with an incredible will to live.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Five decades ago, Lawrence Monk Terry was at the top of his game. In 1972 he won a silver medal with the U.S. rowing team at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich Germany. His position on the team was an important one. He served as the Stroke. That's the term for the one who sets the pace for the rest of the rowers. Since then, his life has been rowing along merrily. Just recently he was a fit and active retiree until an April day, after Monk was doing housework and decided it was time to come inside that his life would take a pause. What happened next would give a whole new meaning to his revered rowing position, The Stroke.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: A diagnosis of childhood cancer came as a shock to the Shoeneck family who found out about their daughter Kenedi's malignant tumor after an unexpected fall. This episode of Hope is Here proves the power of love and creativity as The Sing Me a Story Foundation pairs Kenedi and well-known songwriter Kat Perkins to create a happy and memorable tune that delivers hope, strength, and laughter to a family who needs a reason to smile.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Our youth and all the experiences that makeup one's childhood, good and bad, can affect the person we ultimately become. Yet we often have a choice in that destiny. Ana Viamonte Ros is a woman who confirms that although insurmountable challenges and negative experiences from the past can shape our future, hard work and a determined, healthy mindset can pave the way toward a gratifying life. Today Dr. Viamonte dedicates her life to helping patients strengthen their mental health and conquer childhood traumas while serving as living proof that perseverance and hope make dreams attainable.

programme.title: Kobe Bryant: A Tribute
programme.desc: The sudden and tragic passing of Kobe Bryant, alongside his young daughter Gianna left the world in a stunned silence. Never before has a sporting star held such high esteem outside of their profession… But Kobe Bryant was a superstar. Unmatched on the basketball court and cherished on the red carpet– Kobe’s dedication to his career, his family and his charity work led to him being adored the world over. Directed by Danielle Winter.

programme.title: Selena Gomez: Devotion
programme.desc: After returning from her five year break from music, Selena Gomez has blown the world away with her third studio album Rare. She has transformed over the years, from Disney pop star to award winning film and tv producer. She is one of the biggest stars in Hollywood and is certain one of the most devoted to her art. This is the life and career of Selena Gomez. Directed by Matt Salmon.

programme.title: Taylor Swift: Superstar
programme.desc: Taylor Swift completed her transition from country star to pop superstar. With exclusive interviews and footage, discover the remarkable story of the most powerful woman in Pop Music. Directed by Billy Simpson

programme.title: The Diana Conspiracy: What Happened In Paris?
programme.desc: August 31st 1997- it is a warm summer night in Paris, the city of love. At the back door of the Ritz Hotel four people get into a black Mercedes sedan. One of those people is the most famous woman in the world - Princess Diana. In just a few minutes something is about to happen that will change the world - forever. Since that night, there have been many claims revolving around a criminally orchestrated conspiracy to end Princess Diana's life, many suspicious circumstances surrounding her death have meant that the world has been waiting for answers for over two decades. Just thirty six years old. Diana, Princess of Wales completely changed the public perception of the Royal Family during her time married to Prince Charles. But what really happened in Paris that night? Join us as we uncover the conspiracy theories that could point to an alternative and much more sinister explanation for the sudden and tragic death of Princess Diana. Directed by Nick Randall.

programme.title: The Diana Story: Part I: The Young Princess
programme.desc: In the summer of 1980, a shy young girl arrives at Balmoral Castle. Two years later that girl became a royal princess. At just 20 years old, Lady Diana Spencer married HRH Prince Charles to become HRH Princess Of Wales. From her first steps into the royal world to the birth of her two sons and heirs, this tells the story of Diana's early years being part of the most famous family in the world. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Diana Story: Part II: Broken Hearts
programme.desc: The marriage of Prince Charles and Princess Diana remains infamous for being one of the most turbulent royal weddings in modern history. As the cracks began to form the world watched. What should have been the fairytale couple could not hold any longer. Discover the truth of what really lead to the split, as the world behind palace gates is uncovered. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Diana Story: Part III: Legacy Of Love
programme.desc: A late night phone call from Paris brought news that would rock the world. The sudden and tragic death of Princess Diana devastated millions. Hear what it was really like to be at the eye of the storm, as Diana's closest friend and confidant shares his story of heartbreak and farewell. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Dolly Parton Story: From Rags to Rhinestones
programme.desc: Dolly Parton is one of the most iconic singer-songwriters of all time. From her humble beginnings - one of 12 children living in a shack in Tennessee - Dolly has not only conquered the country music scene, but made her mark on the entertainment industry. Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: The Kardashians: Reality Royalty
programme.desc: The Kardashian family rose to success in 2007 and they are still in the spotlight over a decade later, appealing to an audience of all ages. They have filmed their lives day in and day out, sharing everything from proposals to childbirth, through tears and laughter. With millions of selfies among them and a wide variety of product endorsements, the Kardashians are winning awards and breaking the Internet. They are the royal family of reality TV. Directed by Danielle Winter.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Amy Winehouse
programme.desc: After a very public battle with addiction the world was saddened to hear the shocking news that Amy Winehouse was found dead in her bedroom at the young age of 27. We investigate what really happened during the final 24 hours of the singer’s life, with exclusive interviews and testimonials. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Elvis Presley
programme.desc: The true story of Elvis Presley's last 24 hours is told by the men who knew him best, his Memphis Mafia. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Jimi Hendrix
programme.desc: This documentary offers an in-depth look at Jimi Hendrix's last 24 hours and attempts to clear the air surrounding his tragic passing by including appearances and testimonials from some of the people that knew him best. Directed by Mike Parkinson.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Prince
programme.desc: The world mourned the loss of one of it’s most innovative performers in - April 2016. While Prince’s official autopsy confirmed that the singer died from an overdose of the painkiller fentanyl, investigators have still been looking to clear up some additional mysteries surrounding the case. We take a look into the last 24 hours of his death and look for the real answers as to what happened. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Michael Jackson
programme.desc: The ultimate king of pop Michael Jackson spent his last hours battling insomnia and pleading with his personal physician to give him a powerful anesthetic to combat his chronic sleeplessness according to a search-warrant affidavit. We explore the truth behind this and discover the real facts, with exclusive footage and testimonials. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: The Madeleine McCann Case
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of Madeleine McCanns disappearance in 2003, and follows through the years up until the reservoir search in 2023. Featuring interviews with internationally recognised British Criminologist Dr Graham Hill, and Police Detective Peter Bleksly. It is every parents worst nightmare. Their daughter, only three years of age, taken from her bed.. with no clue left behind. Seconds turned to minutes, minutes into hours, hours into daysâ€¦ Long after a decade, her fate still remains... unknown. Directed by Afsheen Hussein, Jordan Hill, and Brian Aabech.

programme.title: The Moviemakers: Scorsese
programme.desc: 60 years since his directorial debut, Martin Scorsese's life has been dedicated to the past, present and future of cinema. 26 feature films later, the aptly named Caretaker of Cinema continues to push the boundaries of moviemaking. Directed by Louis Dubreuil.

programme.title: The Taylor Swift Story: Dare To Dream
programme.desc: The incredible journey of Taylor Swift all began with a girl, a guitar and a dream. Taylor Swift is a ten time Grammy winner, and the youngest recipient in history of the music industry’s highest honor, follow the story of an artist who turned a childhood dream into an empire. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: Betting on Zero
programme.desc: From director Ted Braun comes a riveting docu-thriller following controversial hedge fund titan Bill Ackman as he puts one billion dollars on the line in his crusade to expose Herbalife as the largest pyramid scheme in history. Blending tales of high-stakes corporate intrigue with working class people caught in the crossfire, Braun paints a stirring picture of the American Dream gone wrong. Directed by Ted Braun.

programme.title: In My Own Words
programme.sub-title: In My Own Words: Little Big
programme.desc: DOCUMENTARY+ invited Ilya Prusikin to share their personal story. Ilya is a musician, songwriter, and lead vocalist of the Russian pop-rave superband, Little Big. Ilya recounts the on the ground events of February 24th, the day Russia invaded Ukraine, the group's journey to seek political asylum in the United States, and navigating being labeled a traitor by the Russian government for being outspoken against the war. Directed by Yasir Masood.

programme.title: Taylor Swift: Superstar
programme.desc: Taylor Swift completed her transition from country star to pop superstar. With exclusive interviews and footage, discover the remarkable story of the most powerful woman in Pop Music. Directed by Billy Simpson

programme.title: Travis Kelce: Sharp, Sturdy, Swift

A Euronews transmite 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana e tem edições em 12 idiomas.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The main event will see two of the light heavyweight division’s most explosive young prospects clash as Romania’s Stefan Latescu (17-3, 8 KO) faces Turkey’s Cem Caceres (16-1, 13 KO). Belgium based Albanian Berjan Peposhi (29-4, 16 KO) will compete in the co-main event. The always exciting featherweight welcomes rising star Ayoub Bourass (14-1, 4 KO) in to make his GLORY debut. International Muay Thai superstar Youssef Boughanem (188-43-8, 120 KO) returns for his sophomore GLORY outing against tough Italian Angelo Volpe (38-5, 12 KO). Former middleweight title contender Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-10, 36 KO) takes on Antwerp’s own Jente Nnamadim (21-5, 11 KO), who comes in to make his GLORY debut in his hometown.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A five-round heavyweight title eliminator between the number one ranked contender Levi Rigters (18-2, 8 KO) and ‘The Golden Wolf’ Bahram Rajabzadeh (69-3, 61 KO). The winner will face ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven (64-10, 21 KO) on December 7 in the main event of COLLISION 7. In the co-main event of the evening, Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-4-1, 13 KO) clashes with Nico ‘Big Sexy’ Horta (23-9, 3 KO) in a monster heavyweight clash with big implication for the rankings. Croatian kickboxing legend Mladen Brestovac (55-14-1, 37 KO) will make his final walk to the ring in his hometown of Zagreb. ‘The Scorpion Sting’ will take on newcomer Karim Dian (16-13, 3 KO) to cap off an illustrious career. Top ten heavyweights Nordine Mahieddine (28-15, 13 KO) and Nikola Filipovic (11-2, 6 KO) will collide in what is a guaranteed barn burner between two prolific KO artist.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: The Smurfs
